## {{wumi}} Welcome to Wumi Support
**Wumi** is an **all-in-one** Discord bot, in **6 languages**: **levels** and rank cards, **moderation** and AI automod, **tickets**, **economy**, **music**, and **automatic announcements** for your YouTube videos, Twitch streams and Instagram posts.

Here you can **ask questions**, **report a bug**, **suggest an idea** and follow **every update** to the bot. Everything is set up in a few clicks with `/setup` or from the **dashboard** at **wumi.fr**.

Use the buttons below to read the **rules** or find **useful links**. A question? Check the **FAQ** first.

## 📜 Server rules
By staying on this server, you agree to these rules and to **[Discord's Terms of Service](https://discord.com/terms)**.

**1. Respect first**
No insults, harassment, discrimination or hate speech. Disagree politely.

**2. No spam**
No flooding, all-caps messages, mass mentions, or pinging staff for no reason.

**3. No advertising**
No ads for servers, bots or services, here or in members' DMs.

**4. Appropriate content**
No NSFW, shocking, illegal or dangerous content. Usernames and avatars included.

**5. Right place, right channel**
For a question or a problem with Wumi, open a **ticket**. Ideas go in **suggestions**, bugs in **bug reports**.

**6. Stay safe**
Never share your token, passwords or personal info. Staff will **never** ask for them.

**7. Staff has the final word**
Follow the team's instructions. If you disagree, open a ticket instead of arguing in the channels.

-# Possible sanctions: warning, mute, kick or ban, depending on severity. Not sure? Open a ticket.
